categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in health biotechnology, manufacturing and selling health supplements, functional beverages, cosmetics, and pet foods. It also engages in OEM/ODM contract manufacturing and direct sales through multi-level marketing. Key segments include health foods, beverages, contract manufacturing, and channel sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biotechnology including microbial fermentation technologies for producing probiotics and fungal extracts such as Ganoderma and Hericium erinaceus. It employs continuous centrifugation for lactic acid bacteria recovery and automated freeze-drying processes. The firm emphasizes proprietary fermentation strains and patented formulations, supported by clinical research and international patent protections.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include health-conscious consumers in Taiwan and international markets, especially Southeast Asia and China. The company serves retail channels such as convenience stores, supermarkets, drugstores, e-commerce platforms, and direct sales via multi-level marketing. It targets demographic groups including elderly, children, and health-focused individuals.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan and sales offices in Taipei. The company has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Mainland China (Shanghai) and Southeast Asia (Malaysia), with plans to expand into Japan, Korea, the US, Canada, and Europe. It actively develops cross-border e-commerce and international distribution channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire supply chain from upstream raw material development (microbial fermentation and proprietary strains), midstream manufacturing (formulation, encapsulation, packaging), to downstream sales and distribution via owned brands and contract manufacturing services. It integrates R&D, production, and marketing internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in health supplements focusing on immune modulation, anti-aging, metabolic health, and joint care. R&D emphasizes clinical validation, new product formats (soft capsules, jellies), and proprietary fermentation technologies. The company invests in sustainable practices, digital marketing, and expanding international OEM/ODM services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of health supplements, functional beverages, cosmetics, and pet foods. Additional income comes from OEM/ODM contract manufacturing and direct sales via multi-level marketing. The company also leverages channel sales of third-party products under its distribution network.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic brand in Taiwan's health supplement market, holding over 50% market share in key fungal product categories. It competes with pharmaceutical, biotech, and food companies entering the health food sector, as well as foreign brands in China and Southeast Asia. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary raw materials, clinical research, and integrated supply chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$11.16 billion in 2024, marking a 4.93% growth over the previous year, with stable net profits and earnings per share around NT$9.78. It has maintained continuous growth over recent years, supported by diversified product lines and expanding international markets. Total assets exceed NT$15 billion with steady equity growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes 'technology, health, and hope' as its core values, offering scientifically validated health products with proprietary fermentation strains and patented ingredients. It differentiates through high-quality, clinically supported formulations, diverse product formats, and sustainable manufacturing practices. Its integrated R&D and supply chain enable customized OEM/ODM solutions, enhancing customer value and market responsiveness.
